title: FACS action units and expression mechanics

queue.claim: ARKit exposes exactly 52 blendshape names (14 eye, 5 brow, 3 cheek, 2 nose, 4 jaw, 23 mouth, 1 tongue, as listed in the data file), 'Left' means the subject's left, and the approximate FACS mapping holds (e.g. mouthShrugLower≈AU17, cheekSquint≈AU6, mouthDimple≈AU14).
queue.query: ARFaceAnchor BlendShapeLocation eyeBlinkLeft mouthShrugLower cheekSquintLeft list

queue.claim: MediaPipe Face Landmarker's 52 blendshape categories are the ARKit names minus tongueOut, plus a '_neutral' category at index 0. Left/right refer to the subject.
queue.query: MediaPipe face landmarker blendshapes category names _neutral index 0 list 52

queue.claim: FLAME has 5,023 vertices, 300 shape and 100 expression components, and has historically been licensed for non-commercial research only. A more permissive release may now exist.
queue.query: FLAME head model license commercial use 2023 release terms

queue.claim: FACS has 44 AUs in total, of which about 30 are tied to specific muscles (12 upper face, 18 lower face). The 2002 revision reorganised the lid codes AU41/42/44. The muscle assignments in the AU table (e.g. AU13 = levator anguli oris, AU14 = buccinator, AU20 = risorius) are per the manual.
queue.query: FACS 2002 revision action units list muscles AU41 AU42 AU44 removed 44 action units 30 anatomically related
